items.title: Test lower planned quantities for all dishes on Fridays at dinner
items.description: Observed evidence: 30% of prepared portions were unsold over 12 days, compared with 20% in the comparable baseline (+10.0 percentage points). Suggested experiment: Check a lower quantity in the simulator, trial it on similar services, and review unsold and stockout results before adopting it.

limitations: Opportunities are indicative and are not guaranteed savings.
Opportunities of overlapping actions must not be summed.
Associated factors are not proven causes.
Unsold portions are recorded surplus; they do not confirm that food was discarded.
